title: Casebook: Payment a TRICARE Select Inpatient Line Would Carry at the Allowed Amount Claimed (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
**Casebook — Appeals and Grievances: the payment the line under review would carry**

Scope: an Allowable Charge Review opened on a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line.

Rule. The payment the line under review would carry is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount, no payment would be made; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount less that payment and the payment is that net amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount itself and the payment is the allowed amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent.

The allowed amount here is the allowed amount claimed on the line under review; the tier whose schedule figures apply is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the line under review was billed under.

Hypothetical: allowed amount claimed 4,620.00; the cost share figured on it comes to 1,250.00 under a daily-charge basis.

| Other insurer's payment counted | Figured on | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| 5,000.00 | — | none: the payment counted is at least the allowed amount |
| 4,620.00 | — | none: equal to the allowed amount |
| 600.00 | 4,020.00 | 4,020.00 less 1,250.00, which is 2,770.00 |
| none | 4,620.00 | 4,620.00 less 1,250.00, which is 3,370.00 |
